data.name: Cave Factory
data.detailed_description:
A 2D side-view factory builder where every grain of dirt, every drop of water, and every wisp of steam in the world is its own simulated pixel — the way they are in Noita. Dig downward through a 500x500 tile cave, trigger landslides, melt ice into water, condense steam into snow, pool liquids around the base of your furnaces, and watch dirt pixels pile up into brand-new dirt tiles when enough of them collect.

Underneath the sim is a real factory game. Mine ore. Sift dirt. Smelt iron. Quench molten iron into steel at exactly the right moment. Lay conveyor belts and inserters, build chests with input and output sides, and grow a vertical factory deep into the earth.

A tech tree gates the late-game machines and recipes — you earn the dirt sifter, stone furnace, input chest, magnets, inserters, and more by playing your way to them.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 and above
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 (3.3 GHz quad-core, Haswell) or AMD Ryzen 3 1200 / FX-8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any DX11 GPU (Feature Level 11.0) — Intel HD Graphics 4000 (2012) or equivalent, 1 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card / Integrated Audio
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 and above
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600 / 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any integrated GPU from 2015+ (Intel HD 520 / AMD Vega iGPU)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card / Integrated Audio

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 Catalina
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M1) or Intel Mac (2015+, dual-core i5)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any Metal-capable Mac (covered by macOS 10.15 minimum)
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 Catalina
  • Processor: Apple Silicon M1 or later or 2018+ quad-core Intel i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple Silicon, or 2015+ Intel Mac
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
